title: One Durable Object per repo as the ref authority
desc: Git consistency reduces to compare-and-swap on refs. A single DO per repo serializes every push without distributed locks.

title: Refs in DO SQLite, objects in R2
desc: Refs are tiny and hot (DO SQLite); objects are large and immutable (R2).

title: Speak git protocol v2 only, translate v0 at the edge
desc: v2 is command-based (ls-refs, fetch, object-info) and maps onto stateless request/response Workers. Legacy v0 dumb/smart clients get a thin shim.

title: Packfile parsing in a Worker with a streaming inflater
desc: A push arrives as one packfile in the git-receive-pack body. Index it on the fly (header, per-object zlib inflate via DecompressionStream, ref-delta/ofs-delta resolution), write objects to R2, then flip refs in the DO.

title: Content-addressed R2 keys
desc: Key objects by SHA so writes are idempotent and retried pushes are harmless.

title: Two-phase push
desc: Phase one writes objects to R2 under a pending prefix. Phase two asks the DO to validate connectivity and atomically advance refs. Crash between phases leaves orphans a janitor alarm sweeps.

title: Precomputed pack slices for clone
desc: Keep a periodically rebuilt full pack in R2 and serve fresh clones as a single R2 range-read stream.

title: Delta bases pinned per repo
desc: Store a small set of hot base objects in DO storage so incremental fetches can delta against them without R2 round trips.

title: Tiny in-DO object cache with alarm-driven eviction
desc: Hot blobs (package.json, lockfiles) served from DO memory/storage; the alarm evicts on a schedule.

title: Shallow and partial clone as first-class filters
desc: blob:none and tree:0 filters map to R2 lazy fetches; each later blob request is exactly one R2 GET.

title: Git LFS natively via presigned R2 URLs
desc: Implement the LFS batch API; objects are already in R2, so upload/download actions are presigned R2 URLs.

title: Bundle-URI support
desc: Advertise bundle-uri so clients pull the bulk pack from an R2 public bucket via CDN, then do a small incremental fetch through the DO.

title: Refs replicated to every region via KV and DO location hints
desc: Reads from nearest edge (KV replica of refs), writes to the single authority DO.

title: Push-triggered CI as a DO alarm chain
desc: A push schedules alarms; each alarm is a stage. No queue service.

title: Live fetch over hibernating WebSockets
desc: Client holds a hibernated WebSocket to the repo DO and is nudged the instant a ref moves.

title: Branch-level Durable Objects for monorepos
desc: Shard refs by namespace so a busy branch does not block a quiet one.

title: Server-side three-way merge in the Worker
desc: Push with a push-option asks the server to merge into main and reject only on real conflicts.

title: Server-side rebase and squash as protocol v2 extensions
desc: Advertised capability; unknown to old clients.

title: Signed refs by default with append-only DO reflog
desc: Every ref move emits a signed record into an append-only log in DO SQLite.

title: Time-travel refs
desc: refs/at/<timestamp>/main resolves from the reflog at fetch time.

title: Snapshots via R2 object versioning of ref state
desc: Every ref flip writes a refs snapshot to R2 so the DO state is recoverable if wiped.

title: Copy-on-write forks
desc: A fork is a new DO pointing at the parent's R2 prefix, writing only new objects to its own prefix.

title: Pre/post-receive hooks as Workers via service bindings
desc: Users deploy a Worker and register it; the repo DO calls it with the ref update payload.

title: Per-blob presigned direct upload for giant pushes
desc: Client PUTs blobs straight to R2 with presigned URLs, then sends the DO a manifest.

title: Wasm git core (gitoxide/libgit2) for delta resolution and merge
desc: Compile git internals to Wasm for heavy lifting; TypeScript for protocol.

title: Search index built on push (D1 FTS / Vectorize)
desc: Post-receive tokenizes changed blobs into a search index.

title: Diff API served with R2 range reads
desc: Serve diffs without reconstructing full files when packs already store deltas.

title: Rate-limited, token-scoped remote URLs
desc: A URL with a scoped token in the path that can only push one branch for one hour.

title: Push from a sibling workspace DO over RPC, no HTTP
desc: The grok-pi workspace DO pushes to the repo DO via DO RPC.

title: Ephemeral repos with a self-destruct alarm
desc: A repo that lives for an hour, then deletes its R2 prefix and DO state.

title: Multi-writer CRDT branches
desc: A branch tip is a CRDT document; the DO merges concurrent edits and materializes a real commit on demand.

title: Agent-native protocol v2 commands (search, explain-diff, suggest-merge)
desc: New v2 commands so an agent harness talks git like it talks tools.

title: Semantic diffs via tree-sitter in Wasm
desc: Function-level diffs for Ruby and JS computed server-side.

title: Commit-as-event-stream
desc: Every commit fans out to Queues, Workers AI, webhooks.

title: Speculative packs
desc: Predict a client's next fetch from previous negotiation and prewarm R2 ranges into the DO cache.

title: Federated remotes via DO-to-DO gossip
desc: Repos subscribe to each other's ref changes; a mesh of mirrors with no hub.

title: Encrypted-at-rest with client-held keys
desc: Objects encrypted before reaching R2; the DO only sees hashes.

title: Deduplication across all repos in one content-addressed bucket
desc: Every copy of lodash stored exactly once, ever.

title: Merkle inclusion proofs on fetch
desc: Return a proof so a client can verify a partial clone without trusting the server.

title: Zero-clone execution: repo as a virtual filesystem inside an agent DO
desc: Read files by hash straight from R2; no checkout ever.

title: Branch previews deployed as Workers on push
desc: Push to preview/foo and a hook deploys the tree via Workers for Platforms.

title: Git as a database driver (ActiveRecord / JS ORM adapter)
desc: Every save is a commit, every query a tree walk, migrations are rebases.

title: Bisect on the server with parallel test Workers
desc: The DO runs a test Worker against midpoints in parallel and returns the culprit.

title: Ref leases
desc: Lock a branch for one client for N minutes, enforced by the DO.

title: Commit graph in Vectorize for semantic git log
desc: Embed messages and diffs so log --semantic works.

title: Time-boxed history with cold-storage checkpoints
desc: Squash commits older than a year into checkpoints, keep full objects in cold R2.

title: Pull-request review data as git objects under refs/reviews
desc: A clone carries its own code review history.

title: Cross-repo atomic pushes
desc: Push to three repos in one request; DOs coordinate a small two-phase commit.

title: GitHub-compatible webhook payloads
desc: Emit the same payloads so existing tooling works.

title: Storage tiering by heat
desc: Untouched objects migrate to R2 infrequent access; hot objects stay in DO.

title: Blame that knows which agent wrote each line
desc: Commit trailers carry agent session IDs; exposed via a protocol command.

title: Offline-first browser client with OPFS and the same Wasm core
desc: Same protocol, same core, browser host.

title: The /info/refs?service= entrypoint and pkt-line codec
desc: Implement pkt-line framing, capability advertisement, and the smart HTTP handshake in a Worker.

title: Auth and multi-tenancy: owner/repo routing to DO ids
desc: idFromName(owner/repo), token verification at the edge, per-repo ACL in DO SQLite.

title: GC and repack as a DO alarm
desc: Periodic alarm walks reachable objects, writes a new pack to R2, deletes unreachable loose objects.

title: Want/have negotiation with a commit-graph in SQLite
desc: Compute the set of objects to send using a commit graph table instead of walking R2.
